cues.en: Hi, and welcome to AI in C#, where we go into the Microsoft Agent Framework, and more specifically in this video, looking at
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 C# AI 課程，介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework；這支影片會特別看看，

cues.en: workflows.
cues.zh: 工作流程。

cues.en: This is my first video in the workflows, so I will give you a short introduction, and then we're going to go in and see a sample of an agent-assisted workflow,
cues.zh: 這是工作流程系列的第一支影片，所以先簡單介紹，再看一個由代理程式協助的工作流程範例，

cues.en: where we will be making some pizzas.
cues.zh: 用來製作披薩。

cues.en: So, but let's learn a bit about the concepts, and they have two main concepts in all of this, and that is executors and
cues.zh: 先了解基本概念，這裡有兩個主要元素：Executor，

cues.en: edges.
cues.zh: 以及 Edge。

cues.en: So a workflow are simply just pieces of code that you want to run, stringed together in a flow.
cues.zh: 工作流程，就是把要執行的程式碼片段，依照流程串接起來。

cues.en: So the flow could be just from one box to another, it could be one box, but if something else, something go out, you
cues.zh: 可以只是從一個方塊走到另一個；也可能根據條件，

cues.en: can fan out, and then aggregate, fan in, and there's multiple different concepts in such workflows.
cues.zh: 向外分流，再彙整收斂，也就是 Fan-out 與 Fan-in，還有其他各種模式。

cues.en: If you know workflows in general, you know that there's a lot of different cases and stuff you can do.
cues.zh: 如果熟悉工作流程，就知道有很多情境與做法。

cues.en: But what we are going to do is, we are going to build the executors, and we are going to define the edges on how these executors talk to each other.
cues.zh: 我們要做的，就是建立執行器，再定義執行器之間如何透過邊互相傳遞資料。

cues.en: And in order to better understand it, I made a small sample, which we'll go to.
cues.zh: 為了更容易理解，我做了一個小範例。

cues.en: And the smaller workflows are in general, the more contrived they are, but I've tried to make something that could be sort of realistic,
cues.zh: 範例越小，通常就越刻意；我希望這個案例稍微貼近真實情境，

cues.en: and for that reason, it's also a little bigger to see in code, but it's more realistic compared to just having a workflow that went from one box to another, and then
cues.zh: 因此程式碼會多一點，但比只從一個方塊走到另一個方塊，然後，

cues.en: ended.
cues.zh: 結束，更有參考價值。

cues.en: So the idea is that we have a user that are hungry, and they, via a chatbot or some kind of input field, just
cues.zh: 情境是一位肚子餓的使用者，透過聊天機器人或某種輸入欄位，

cues.en: ask for a pizza.
cues.zh: 提出訂購披薩的需求。

cues.en: And then we will put that order into a workflow, and the first thing we'll do is we'll have an order parser that will
cues.zh: 訂單會送入工作流程；第一步是訂單解析器，

cues.en: turn out what have the customer actually asked for, and turn that into something that are more structured.
cues.zh: 判斷顧客實際要求什麼，再轉成結構化資料。

cues.en: Then we will parse that structure that the AI will build here into a stock checker, which right now don't have any AI, but it could have, but it could also have
cues.zh: 接著把 AI 建立的資料交給庫存檢查器；這一步目前沒有使用 AI，但也可以加入，

cues.en: tool calling to a real inventory management system, and what we have.
cues.zh: 甚至透過工具呼叫查詢真實的庫存管理系統。

cues.en: But essentially, it's just a hard-coded thing that some stocks can be missing, and if it's missing, it should go and make a warning where we use an AI to generate
cues.zh: 目前只是寫死部分配料可能缺貨；缺貨時就產生警告，再利用 AI，

cues.en: some kind of message back to the user, and if they want to have some replacement of some of the stock.
cues.zh: 寫一段回覆，告訴顧客情況，並詢問是否要替換配料。

cues.en: And if all stock is there, we of course have some success, and we can make the pizza.
cues.zh: 如果配料都有庫存，就走成功分支，開始製作披薩。

cues.en: So this would be a fairly simple workflow, but it will also be an AI-assisted
cues.zh: 這是一個相當簡單，但由 AI 協助的，

cues.en: workflow, in that these two executors have some AI injected.
cues.zh: 工作流程，因為其中兩個執行器使用了 AI。

cues.en: But beyond that, we could have made this with any other workflow, NuGet package, if we wanted to, but given that it is here, we will of course use them together.
cues.zh: 除此之外，也可以使用其他工作流程 NuGet 套件實作；但既然 Agent Framework 已經提供，就直接整合使用。

cues.en: So let's go into code and see all this in action, and we'll just simply take it line by line here, and then we
cues.zh: 接著進入程式碼，逐行查看這個流程，

cues.en: will see it up and running.
cues.zh: 再實際執行。

cues.en: So first up, we have our configuration, just our setup of our agents, and we have made a small agent factory here, just to
cues.zh: 首先是設定與代理程式初始化；這裡建立一個小型 AgentFactory，

cues.en: fill it out here, because we need two agents.
cues.zh: 方便產生我們需要的兩個代理程式。

cues.en: One that is an order taker, and in this case, we're using structured output to get a pizza order, and the pizza order is
cues.zh: 第一個負責接單，使用結構化輸出取得 PizzaOrder；這個訂單物件，

cues.en: just something that have a size, what toppings they want, and at some point, what kind of warnings are there to this order.
cues.zh: 包含尺寸、配料，以及之後可能產生的警告。

cues.en: So the agent here is just take whatever the customer asks for, and turn it into a pizza order, and that's the only thing it can do.
cues.zh: 代理程式只負責把顧客的要求轉成 PizzaOrder，沒有其他功能。

cues.en: The other one is, if there's any problems with the pizza, it should explain to the
cues.zh: 另一個代理程式則在訂單發生問題時，向，

cues.en: customer or to the user that their pizza order can't be met, so we don't give a stock answer, but a real answer from
cues.zh: 顧客解釋為什麼無法完成訂單，讓回覆不是固定模板，而是由，

cues.en: an agent.
cues.zh: 代理程式產生的自然說明。

cues.en: So nothing new here, we have done this all the other places we have gone through this code.
cues.zh: 這些都不是新內容，前面的範例已經介紹過。

cues.en: I've just put it out into a separate class, so it doesn't fill up, and we don't get the full meaning of this.
cues.zh: 我只是把它們放進獨立類別，避免主程式太長，模糊了流程重點。

cues.en: Next up, we have four executors, because as we saw in our thing here, we have one, two, three, four, so we need four of these.
cues.zh: 接著是四個執行器，對應圖上的一、二、三、四個步驟。

cues.en: Could some of them have been together?
cues.zh: 其中有些可以合併嗎？

cues.en: Of course they could.
cues.zh: 當然可以。

cues.en: Could everything have just been in one class with if statements?
cues.zh: 全部放進一個類別，用 if 判斷可以嗎？

cues.en: Yes, it could, but the idea is, of course, that you can make these executors.
cues.zh: 也可以，但這裡的目的，就是讓你學會建立執行器。

cues.en: You can perhaps even make executors that can be reused across multiple workflows, and in general just that you don't need to string all
cues.zh: 甚至可以建立能在多個工作流程重複使用的執行器，不必每次，

cues.en: this up.
cues.zh: 重新串接所有邏輯。

cues.en: Beyond that, the workflows can be resumed and suspended, and have human in the loop, and be long running, and all kinds of things,
cues.zh: 另外，工作流程也支援暫停、繼續、人員介入，以及長時間執行等功能，

cues.en: but that will be for another video.
cues.zh: 不過那些留到其他影片再介紹。

cues.en: For this one, we're just going to make a simple one.
cues.zh: 這次先建立簡單版本。

cues.en: So let's go back to code, and see our first executor.
cues.zh: 回到程式碼，看看第一個執行器。

cues.en: So our first executor is an order parser, and as we can see, it gets the order taker agent in.
cues.zh: 第一個是 OrderParser，它會接收接單代理程式。

cues.en: And if we look at an executor, the way they work is you make a class,
cues.zh: 建立執行器的方式，是先定義類別，

cues.en: and you make it extend the reflection executor.
cues.zh: 再繼承 ReflectingExecutor。

cues.en: They are all called reflection executor, so that's the only one at the moment.
cues.zh: 目前使用的都是 ReflectingExecutor 這個類別。

cues.en: And it's of type this, and we give it a name.
cues.zh: 指定自身型別，並提供名稱。

cues.en: And then we need to tell what kind this executor, what should it do.
cues.zh: 接著說明這個執行器要處理什麼。

cues.en: Well, in our case, we wanted to handle a message, and that message would be that it has an input of string, meaning that
cues.zh: 這裡要處理訊息，輸入型別是 string，也就是，

cues.en: the order from the user as a string, and the output should be the pizza order.
cues.zh: 顧客的文字訂單，輸出型別則是 PizzaOrder。

cues.en: And when we have this interface, we need to implement a handle async here.
cues.zh: 實作這個介面後，就需要提供 HandleAsync。

cues.en: We could have this interface multiple times, so it could have been that it was in text, but it could also be an MP4
cues.zh: 同一個類別可以實作多種處理介面，所以輸入不一定只能是文字，也可能是 MP4，

cues.en: file with the voice of the user, and we could parse that, and so on.
cues.zh: 包含使用者的語音，再進行解析等。

cues.en: So an executor can have multiple handles if need be, but in the above case, we'll just keep one.
cues.zh: 因此執行器必要時可以有多個 Handle，不過這裡只保留一個。

cues.en: And here we just do normal agent work.
cues.zh: 方法裡只是一般的代理程式呼叫。

cues.en: We're going to use structured output to get a pizza order back, so we're essentially just taking the string and turning it into an
cues.zh: 透過結構化輸出取得 PizzaOrder，本質上就是把字串轉成，

cues.en: object.
cues.zh: 物件。

cues.en: We'll set a breakpoint here, so we can see that in a little while.
cues.zh: 在這裡設中斷點，稍後再看。

cues.en: Next up, we have our stock checker, so our stock checker is fairly simple.
cues.zh: 接著是 StockChecker，庫存檢查器相當簡單。

cues.en: It's just going to take a pizza order in and return a pizza order out.
cues.zh: 接收 PizzaOrder，也回傳 PizzaOrder。

cues.en: And if we do that, we just get our order.
cues.zh: 也就是先取得訂單，

cues.en: We loop to all the different toppings that the previous step extracted from us, and then we have hard-coded here right now that
cues.zh: 逐一檢查上一步擷取出的配料；目前這裡寫死，

cues.en: if it's mushrooms, one of the toppings, we simulate that that's out of stock.
cues.zh: 如果其中一項是蘑菇，就模擬缺貨。

cues.en: In real life, we will, of course, have had some code here, or maybe even an agent that could figure out if it said
cues.zh: 實際應用當然會寫其他程式，甚至使用代理程式來判斷，

cues.en: the word mushroom or mushrooms or some kind of shiitake mushroom or whatever, so an AI
cues.zh: mushroom、mushrooms，或香菇等不同名稱，

cues.en: could help us find the right topping for just based on text.
cues.zh: 讓 AI 根據文字找出正確的配料。

cues.en: But in this case, we're just simulating that if it's mushrooms we are out of, we will add a warning to our pizza order, or else we'll just write out that we
cues.zh: 不過這裡只模擬蘑菇缺貨，遇到就替訂單加入警告；否則輸出，

cues.en: are able to add that topping onto the pizza and reduce the stock.
cues.zh: 配料可以加入披薩，並扣除庫存。

cues.en: So we'll also set a breakpoint here when we get to that.
cues.zh: 這裡也設個中斷點。

cues.en: Next we have the two end results, either a success, which is fairly simple, we'll just
cues.zh: 接著是兩種最終結果：成功的情況很簡單，直接，

cues.en: say pizza okay, or a warning where we give an agent, because we want to check
cues.zh: 表示披薩可以製作；警告的情況則會使用代理程式，

cues.en: the warning, get all the warning text out, and pass that into the agent that it needs to explain what we are out of
cues.zh: 取出所有警告文字，交給代理程式，說明哪些配料缺貨，

cues.en: and what they can do.
cues.zh: 以及顧客可以怎麼處理。

cues.en: And here we will probably send an email or an SMS message or whatever our system would do.
cues.zh: 實際系統可能會在這裡寄送電子郵件、簡訊，或其他通知。

cues.en: So these are the four we have, but now we need to explain the edges.
cues.zh: 以上就是四個執行器，接著要定義它們之間的 Edge。

cues.en: This one here is of course starting the workflow, but one, two, three edges.
cues.zh: 這裡是工作流程起點，另外有三條邊。

cues.en: And the first edge is just passing along, so we are simply going in and building a workflow builder.
cues.zh: 第一條邊只是把資料往下傳，所以先建立 WorkflowBuilder。

cues.en: And what we are telling the workflow builder is that the first executor should be the order parser, which we saw here.
cues.zh: 告訴 Builder，第一個執行器是剛才看到的 OrderParser。

cues.en: So that would always be the start of this workflow.
cues.zh: 它永遠是這個工作流程的起點。

cues.en: And then we are telling it make an edge, meaning draw an arrow between these two boxes, from the order parser to the stock
cues.zh: 然後加入一條邊，也就是在兩個方塊間畫箭頭，從 OrderParser 指向，

cues.en: checker.
cues.zh: StockChecker。

cues.en: And there, it is very important that we then see that this one had an output of a pizza order, while this had an
cues.zh: 這裡很重要：前者輸出 PizzaOrder，而後者，

cues.en: input of a pizza order.
cues.zh: 必須接收 PizzaOrder。

cues.en: If these don't fit, the workflow will not run.
cues.zh: 如果輸入輸出型別不相符，工作流程不會繼續。

cues.en: It will simply just stop at the first step.
cues.zh: 它會停在第一個步驟。

cues.en: But again, a simple case here, we're just parsing along after one have finished at work, the second one will take over.
cues.zh: 這裡是簡單情況，第一個完成工作後，就把資料交給第二個。

cues.en: And then, once we have the output of our stock checker that enhanced the order with warnings or not, we go in and add
cues.zh: 接著，StockChecker 回傳可能帶有警告的訂單後，再加入，

cues.en: a switch edge, meaning we are going to branch into two different things.
cues.zh: Switch Edge，根據條件分成兩條路。

cues.en: And the way we branch is we build an add switch, and we do a switch builder, where we add a case that says,
cues.zh: 寫法是呼叫 AddSwitch，使用 SwitchBuilder 加入條件，

cues.en: if the warning is zero, then it's a success.
cues.zh: 如果警告數是零，就走成功分支。

cues.en: If the warning is different from zero, then it's a warning.
cues.zh: 如果警告數不是零，就走警告分支。

cues.en: And that is actually everything to define our workflow.
cues.zh: 這樣就完成工作流程的定義。

cues.en: But you can imagine you could make a much more advanced workflow if you wanted to.
cues.zh: 你也可以想像，必要時能建立更複雜的流程。

cues.en: And again, there is multiple steps here for various fan out, meaning take this one step
cues.zh: 還有很多 Fan-out 的步驟模式，也就是從一個步驟，

cues.en: and start these two steps, or fan in, take these two, three, four steps, and aggregate them into one step, and so on.
cues.zh: 分成兩個；或 Fan-in，把兩、三、四個步驟的結果彙整成一個。

cues.en: But more on that in future videos.
cues.zh: 這些會在之後的影片介紹。

cues.en: But for now, we're just going to build our workflow, and now we have the option to run it.
cues.zh: 目前先 Build 工作流程，接著就能執行。

cues.en: And in order to run it, we, of course, need some input.
cues.zh: 執行時當然需要輸入。

cues.en: And in our case, we've just hard-coded here, make a big pepperoni pizza with mushrooms and onions.
cues.zh: 這裡直接寫死：「做一個大尺寸的義式臘腸披薩，加蘑菇與洋蔥。」

cues.en: And then we are going to use this in-process execution, which will go in and
cues.zh: 接著使用 InProcessExecution，

cues.en: stream our workflow, meaning we can, on the fly, see that something happens, because workflows could
cues.zh: 以串流方式執行工作流程，讓我們即時知道發生了什麼，因為工作流程可能，

cues.en: be several hours, perhaps.
cues.zh: 持續好幾個小時。

cues.en: So we can see live what is going on.
cues.zh: 因此可以即時追蹤進度。

cues.en: We could also just have run it, and then we will first see the results at the very end of the workflow.
cues.zh: 也可以直接執行，等整個流程結束才取得結果。

cues.en: But we're giving our in-process executor our workflow and our input, and we get a
cues.zh: 這裡把工作流程與輸入交給行程內執行器，取得，

cues.en: streaming run, which we can then watch here.
cues.zh: StreamingRun，再於下方觀察。

cues.en: And watch means we can get the various workflow events.
cues.zh: Watch 會讓我們取得各種工作流程事件。

cues.en: So there's various events you can get.
cues.zh: 有很多種事件可以接收。

cues.en: So, for example, this is every time an executor is done, but it could also be every time an executor starts, every time the workflow starts.
cues.zh: 例如每次執行器完成，也可以追蹤執行器開始，或整個工作流程開始。

cues.en: And there can be groups inside workflows called super steps.
cues.zh: 工作流程內部也能分成稱為 Superstep 的群組。

cues.en: But for now, we are just going to check every time something ends.
cues.zh: 不過這裡只觀察每次完成的事件。

cues.en: We will just write it out as completed.
cues.zh: 收到後，就輸出已完成。

cues.en: The executors, by themselves, take care of the rest.
cues.zh: 其餘處理由各執行器自己負責。

cues.en: So now I think we should just set a breakpoint and walk through it while we see the output.
cues.zh: 接著設個中斷點，一邊執行一邊看輸出。

cues.en: So I am running the wrong one.
cues.zh: 現在啟動錯專案了。

cues.en: Let me quickly do this.
cues.zh: 先快速調整。

cues.en: And let's see it in action then.
cues.zh: 接著實際看看。

cues.en: So we're getting our configuration, and we are building our executors.
cues.zh: 先取得設定，並建立執行器。

cues.en: So they don't do anything at build time.
cues.zh: 建立時不會執行任何工作。

cues.en: They are just being marked up.
cues.zh: 只是把它們準備好。

cues.en: Then we're going to make our edges and our switches, and we can also set some breakpoints in our switch so we can see that a little while.
cues.zh: 接著建立邊與分支，也可以在分支條件上設中斷點，稍後觀察。

cues.en: So now I'm going to start to run.
cues.zh: 現在準備開始執行。

cues.en: And as we saw, we set a breakpoint in the pass order.
cues.zh: 剛才已經在解析訂單的位置設了中斷點。

cues.en: So we set a breakpoint in the executor here, and we're going to set one in success.
cues.zh: 接著在這個執行器與成功分支都設一下。

cues.en: Not that we're going to read it because we are asking for mushrooms.
cues.zh: 不過這次有要求蘑菇，應該不會進入成功分支。

cues.en: And we're going to set one here.
cues.zh: 這裡也設一個。

cues.en: So whenever I start this, it now begins.
cues.zh: 一開始執行，流程就正式開始。

cues.en: And the first thing that happens is we hit the order parser, and the input was a string that just was make a big pepperoni pizza with mushroom and onions.
cues.zh: 第一個進入的是 OrderParser，輸入文字就是大份義式臘腸披薩，加蘑菇與洋蔥。

cues.en: And we are going to take that message and just use our agent in order to get our response back, which will be some
cues.zh: 我們把這段訊息交給代理程式，取得回覆，也就是，

cues.en: JSON, in this case a large pizza with toppings pepperoni, mushrooms, and onions, and no warnings,
cues.zh: JSON：尺寸是 Large，配料有 Pepperoni、Mushrooms、Onions，警告則是空的，

cues.en: of course, because we don't have any.
cues.zh: 因為目前還沒有檢查庫存。
